lines.text: @sai_front opens a thin @laptop_silver on a kitchen table, and the screen lights his face blue in the dark room.
Only the screen lights the scene.

new_beats.text: His eyes widen as the screen brightens and a faint smile spreads.

writes.note: I added a timed beat at 2.5 s where his face reacts to the screen light.

reply.rationale: The shot shows the laptop opening but lacks a human reaction. A short moment beat after the open adds it without changing the words.
